ai.summary: Complete database layer for product management with PostgreSQL schemas, RLS policies, indexes, and TypeScript query functions. Designed for Bebarter marketplace with Supabase integration and security-first approach. Supports full product lifecycle: draft, active, sold, archived.
use_cases: Create products table in Supabase with complete schema
Apply RLS policies for secure product access control
Run migrations for product schema setup
Use TypeScript query functions for product CRUD operations
List products with filters (category, seller, status, price range)
Manage product inventory and stock levels
Track product status lifecycle (draft to sold)
examples: -- Execute schema in Supabase SQL Editor
const products = await listProducts(supabase, { status: 'active' }, { limit: 20 })
const newProduct = await createProduct(supabase, { name: 'Item', price: 100, seller_id: userId })
